description:
Check that a file (path and fingerprint) was part of an anchored manifest, and that the manifest is on
chain. A changed file, or a renamed one, fails.

path.description: The file's path exactly as listed
path.title: Path

proof.description: Optional Merkle proof, to check without this server's index
proof.title: Proof

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file you hold
sha256.title: Sha256

name: anchor_manifest_check
title: Check a file against a manifest
